adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The physician structures the full encounter by investing in the beginning, eliciting the patient's perspective, demonstrating empathy, and investing in the end, directly matching the Four Habits Model.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: NURSE, VALUE, Ask-Tell-Ask, and Best Case/Worst Case are narrower frameworks for emotion, ICU family conferences, iterative information exchange, or scenario planning rather than full-visit structure.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: All four named habits are instantiated sequentially, so the answer is framework-specific rather than generic communication quality.
